CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for [Model Workshop Manager](https://github.com/Lucifix/model-workshop-manager) — a self-hosted, single-user app for tracking your model kit stash, paint shelf, supplies and builds.
The app is developed and the Docker image is built in the main project repository; this repository only holds the Community Apps template. For questions and bug reports, use the project's [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Lucifix/model-workshop-manager/discussions) or [issue tracker](https://github.com/Lucifix/model-workshop-manager/issues).
